title: Windows drive letter in vm.box_url is ignored
body:
This is a case of missing a single slash character in [box_add.rb](https://github.com/mitchellh/vagrant/blob/master/lib/vagrant/action/builtin/box_add.rb#L37).
### Vagrant version

1.8.4
### Host operating system

Windows 7
### Guest operating system

CentOS 6
### Vagrantfile

``` ruby
Vagrant.configure(2) do |config|
  config.vm.box = my/centos6-64"
  config.vm.box_url = 'Y:/vagrant/centos6-64/centos6-64.box'
end
```
### Debug output

https://gist.github.com/rossi-fi/1d9dcee1594dfa478ac988365d0fc641
### Expected behavior

Vagrant finds .box file from any attached drive on Windows, eg. `Y:/vagrant/centos6-64/centos6-64.box`.
### Actual behavior

`vagrant up` fails with error `Couldn't open file /vagrant/centos6-64/centos6-64.box`.
### Steps to reproduce
1. Store .box file locally on a different drive from the Vagrantfile
2. Run `vagrant up`
### Root cause

Windows paths are converted to URLs with `file:` scheme in [box_add.rb](https://github.com/mitchellh/vagrant/blob/master/lib/vagrant/action/builtin/box_add.rb#L37). Three slashes should follow `file:` but only two are added. As a result cURL interprets the drive letter as the authority section of the URL.

There is a [cURL FAQ](https://curl.haxx.se/docs/faq.html#file_URLs_containing_drive_le) explaining how it interprets file: URLs containing drive letters.

```
INFO subprocess: Starting process: ["C:\\HashiCorp\\Vagrant\\embedded\\bin/curl.EXE", "-q", "--fail", "--location", "--max-redirs", "10", "--user-agent", "Vagrant/1.8.4 (+https://www.vagrantup.com; ruby2.2.3)", "--continue-at", "-", "--output", "C:/Users/user/.vagrant.d/tmp/box326e5f762d3b6d73c257a7f3fd71a608acbf5bc3", "file://Y:/vagrant/centos6-64/centos6-64.box"]
DEBUG subprocess: Selecting on IO
DEBUG subprocess: stderr: curl: (37) Couldn't open file /vagrant/centos6-64/centos6-64.box`
```
